description:
Create design subtrees with nested JSX-like markup; nesting defines hierarchy. Keep each logical unit in one call. The complete tree is validated before creation; a structural or parameter error rejects the whole call with an error code and JSX path, without creating partial nodes.

`jsx` only CREATES. Omitting `parent` creates a new top-level root on the active page; only requested deliverables belong there. Additions and repairs need a known parent; never create a top-level scratch node. Use `edit` or `set_*` for properties and `reconcile_apply` for structural rewrites. Never delete and recreate the same logical element as a repair.

## Minimal form

```jsx
<frame name="Account Row" layout="row" items="center" gap={8} padding={12} w="fill" fill="#FFFFFF">
  <icon name="Settings Icon" icon="lucide:settings" size={20} fill="#334155" />
  <text name="Account Label" w="fill">Account</text>
</frame>
```

## Syntax

Containers: `frame`, `group`, `section`, and `component`; only these accept element children. `text` accepts text/number values but no nested elements. Leaves `rect`, `ellipse`, `line`, `star`, `polygon`, `vector`, `icon`, `image`, and `instance` never accept children. `group` and `section` create frame-like containers, not native Group or Section nodes. `image` creates a gray placeholder frame; it does not place image content.

Container props include `layout`, `justify`, `items`, `wrap`, `w`, `h`, min/max size, `padding`/`p`, `gap`, `crossGap`, `fill`/`bg`, `rounded`/`corner`/`radius`, `stroke`/`strokeW`, `shadow`/`blur`/`bgblur`/`glass`, `opacity`, `overflow`, `rotate`, and `layoutPositioning`. Text adds `size`, `weight`, `font`, `lineHeight`, `tracking`, `maxLines`, `truncate`, and `paragraphSpacing`. Shapes add paint, stroke, dimensions, and `arc` where applicable.

- Use `justify="start|center|end|between"`; `space-between` is also accepted. Figma has no `space-around` or `space-evenly`; use fill-width children or `between` with parent padding.
- Use `items="start|center|end|baseline|stretch"`. On row/column containers, `stretch` fills each child's unset cross axis; explicit child sizes win. `fill` is not an alignment value.
- Use `padding={16}`, `padding="12 20"`, `padding={[12,20]}`, or `padding={[8,16,12,16]}`. For named sides use `padding={{top:8,right:16,bottom:12,left:16}}`; never wrap that object in an array.
- Use `stroke="#334155" strokeW={1}` or `stroke="1 #334155"`. `strokeWidth` is accepted only as a compatibility alias; do not emit it.
- Tint icons with `fill`, never `color`. Use `justify="between"` instead of empty spacer frames. Fit padding, gaps, and child heights inside fixed-height roots.
- Give floating decoration inside auto layout `layoutPositioning="absolute"`. Put a full-frame background on its parent.

Inside `<text>`, a blank line creates a paragraph, `{'\n'}` a hard break, and one source newline collapses to a space. Use `maxLines={N}` with a bounded width for multi-line ellipsis; use `truncate="end|none"` for explicit single-box truncation. Do not emit Figma enum values such as `textTruncation="ENDING"`, or ambiguous CSS `clip`. Mixed styles support `**bold**`, `*italic*`, `***bold italic***`, `~~strike~~`, `{color:#EF4444|red}`, and `{size:32|large}`. Styles may nest; use props for uniform styling.

Paints accept hex and a CSS-like gradient subset: `linear-gradient(135deg, #667EEA 0%, #764BA2 100%)`, centered `radial-gradient(circle, #FFFFFF, #000000)`, and `conic-gradient(from 0deg, #FF0000, #00FF00, #0000FF)`. Stops auto-distribute; explicit positions use `%`. Radial `at` position syntax, including `circle at ...` and `ellipse at ...`, named colors, `hsl()`, and other CSS positions are unsupported. Effects include `shadow="0,8,32,0,#0006"`, `blur={10}`, `bgblur={20}`, and `glass={20}` or `glass={{radius:20,depth:8,refraction:0.5,lightAngle:45,lightIntensity:0.8,dispersion:0.2}}`.

Bind `fill`, `bg`, or `stroke` with a qualified token string such as `bg="$Theme/Bg/Surface"`. Object literals do not bind variables; use `$Collection/Path`.

Compact forms include `<instance ref="Button" variant="Size=Large" />`, `<line w="fill" stroke="#E5E7EB" />`, and `<ellipse w={120} h={120} arc="0 270 0.65" fill="#4F46E5" />`.

## Repetition and limits

Drive repeats from local literal data and one template. Expressions may return arrays:

```jsx
{[['Revenue', '$48k'], ['Users', '12.3k']].map(([label, value]) =>
  <frame name={`${label} Card`}><text>{label}</text><text weight={600}>{value}</text></frame>
)}
```

Mapped children need no `key=`. In `.map()`, derive every explicit `name`, including nested children, from stable item data (for example, ``name={`${label} CTA`}``); otherwise omit it. Never repeat `Check`, `Feature Label`, or `CTA`. Use `range(n).map(i => ...)` for indexed repeats; `range(n)` is capped at 1000. Template execution is capped at 10000 ms. Use local literal data only; no globals, assignment, loops, `new`, regex, `await`.

## Grid

Use `layout="grid"` for a two-dimensional matrix and give it a width; use row or column for one dimension.

- Start with `cols={N}`. Omit `rows` for content-sized rows; gaps use `rowGap` and `colGap`.
- Tracks use fixed `N`/`Npx`, flexible `Nfr`, or `hug`: `colSizes="240px 1fr 1fr"`, `rowSizes="80px 1fr"`. Track strings infer counts; `1fr` rows make equal-height bands.
- `autoFlow` packs children row-major; `autoRows` adds rows. Children accept `colSpan`, `rowSpan`, `alignX`, and `alignY`.
- With content-sized rows, omit child `h`: ordinary cells hug content, while a `rowSpan` child fills the tracks it spans. Fixed/flexible rows also fill by default.
- `rowStart` and `colStart` are zero-based manual anchors; do not combine them with `autoFlow`. Grid cells ignore `justify` and `items`.

## Returned handles

The result maps distinctly named nodes in `namedNodes: {name: id}`. Repeated names also return `namedNodeCollisions: {name: id[]}` and a warning. Multiple top-level elements return `roots`; use them only when the requested deliverable genuinely has multiple roots.

Use returned IDs or inspect a known parent before editing; never infer IDs from order or adjacent values. Before finishing, repair duplicate names, overflow, and other actionable final-state issues. Lint a returned root ID, never `/`; the page root rejects lint. Validation errors report all deterministic issues together; correct those paths and retry the call.

parent.description: Target parent node ID. If omitted, creates a top-level root on the active page.
